description: This PHP script provides the backend for displaying a list of available keywords in the TestLink project. It initializes the page, processes request parameters, and interacts with the database to set up variables for rendering the keywords view.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP empty class used for dynamically creating objects to store properties.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an arguments object for the keywords view page, processing request parameters and user info.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view the keywords management feature in the project.
